verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an official, fully-featured `bw` CLI for accessing and managing the vault, with personal API key authentication documented for automated workflows. A runtime probe confirmed it installs from npm and runs, and that its `bw serve` mode exposes the vault as a local REST API an agent can query; a community user also reports using it hands-on. missing for 10: in-pack documentation of the CLI's command reference and machine-readable/structured output options for agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
Using the personal API key for CLI authentication is suitable for automated workflows
the official bw CLI installs keylessly from npm (@bitwarden/cli, registry latest 2026.8.0) and prints its version
